description: Web bundle size budget (KB). Regression guard: critical path + eager/feature chunks and release total without language-on-demand catalogs. #1286 uses route-scoped shared chunks instead of a global eager __common; the hard 800 KiB Brotli ceiling is measured from the complete script set of the worst generated HTML route with no tolerance. #1372 adds eager.maxRequests / eager.maxRequestsByRoute: the same script sets counted as REQUESTS, because at 150 ms mobile latency round-trips dominate over bytes and the byte ceiling alone misses that regression. Per-route ceilings are pinned to measured values with no spare (first set 2026-08-10, re-ratcheted 2026-08-25 - see #1543 below), so a route-local split regression cannot hide under the global worst route; maxRequests is the fallback ceiling for routes without their own line. Counts only eager <script> tags in the exported HTML — runtime import() chunks (roughly half of the 62 JS requests measured on /search before app-hydrated) need a network probe and are NOT covered here. #1393 adds eager.payloadRoutes: WHICH routes carry a heavy first-party payload, because neither the byte nor the request ceiling answers that — a module reachable from two or more async roots is hoisted into a shared chunk with no check on who needs it, and both earlier gates stay green. Payloads are identified by a marker string in the built JS, never by chunk name: __shared-N is renumbered between builds (the same payload was __shared-5, __shared-14 and __shared-59 within one session). maxRoutes is a one-way ratchet pinned to the measured count; mustNotLoad pins already-freed routes by name so the ratchet cannot trade the home page for the map. BE/UK/PL/EN remain deferred and separately budgeted. Other budgets keep at most 5% tolerance. #1543 (ninth ROUTE-BUNDLE-001 recurrence) fixes the eager scatter in two layers and re-curates the pins against it. Bundler layer: patches/@expo+metro-config merges groups that land on an identical route set, on top of the route-similarity merge that precedes it (#1721 moved that metric from async owner chunks to delivery routes and dropped the 512 KiB cluster ceiling). Route layer: the trip planner opens on the `route` tab, so the people/export/more tab trees and the owner edit panel moved behind components/trips/planning/tripPlanDeferredSections.web.tsx. Worst-route eager Brotli 852.6 -> 760.8 KB; per-route requests index 44 -> 14, search 39 -> 9, map 45 -> 14, quests 42 -> 12, travels/[param] 53 -> 16, trips/plan/[id] 62 -> 19. maxRequests / maxRequestsByRoute are therefore ratcheted DOWN to the counts measured on 2026-08-25 with no spare (the stale 30-51 pins could no longer see a scatter regression), and the two current worst routes get their own line. Other ceilings are raised ONLY where the overshoot is fully attributed to product growth, never to go green: locale-be/uk raw grew 6.3%/6.2%, and modelling the built chunk as the escaped source (non-ASCII -> \uXXXX, 6 bytes per Cyrillic char) over i18n/locales predicts +6.3%/+6.3% from the sources between the pin commit b977ef61 (2026-07-17) and HEAD - four independent points (be/uk x pin/HEAD) match the measured chunks within 1 KB. TravelDetailsMapSection raw grew 6.9% while its chunk-exclusive source set grew 5.2% (25.1 KB: UnifiedTravelCard, affiliateConfig, routeFileParser, api/misc, plus this ticket's own useCountryCodeByCoords chokepoint); its gzip pin stays at 22.2 because gzip is not breached. TOTAL gzip grew 6.9% while non-deferred first-party source grew 7.1% (879 KB, 1835 -> 1935 files) since the TOTAL pin commit 7d0db398 (2026-08-08); +10.6 KB of that is the price of the route-tab split itself (186 -> 195 chunks), paid to take 30.5 KB Brotli off every first load of the worst route. TOTAL raw is NOT re-pinned - it is not breached. The 2026-08-30 release catch-up re-curates only measured breaches after 692 files / 7,264 net production LOC landed since #1543: quest country landings add 64 generated routes and a 15.2 KB route chunk (then still summed with seven unrelated index chunks; split per owner by #2085, see below); the deferred travel transition/error state grows TravelDetailsPostLcpRuntime source 2.3 -> 3.6 KB; and locale source growth since b977ef61 predicts BE/UK/PL/EN +6.2%/+6.1%/+5.6%/+5.5%, matching the built catalog deltas. The same clean build remains below the hard eager payload ceiling (744.3 < 775 KB Brotli) and keeps geoCountryOutlines on zero eager routes, so the exact request pins are moved to the measured 2026-08-30 composition with no spare rather than changing the serializer. #2085 splits the `index` basename group per owner. Metro names a route chunk after its source file, so the home page, /quests, the quest city and country landings, the two trips routes and the expo-location / expo-video package entries all export as index-<hash>.js, and one summed ceiling hid which of them grew (#2082/#2083). Each `index:<owner>` row carries a `marker` string that the guard finds in exactly one index chunk of the built JS (a root testID, a route-file literal or a package export name; never the content hash or the file order, and source maps are off in the prod export). A file that matches no marker or several, and a marker carried by several files or by none, fail the guard with the file name and size instead of being summed back. The owner ceilings split the former `index` 192.4/48.9/42 KB exactly (owner decision in #2083: no raise): measured 193.4/49.8/43.2 KB in sum on 33c5fb4db (2026-09-24), each row = its measurement x former total / sum of the row measurements, rounded to 0.1 KB by largest remainder and never below the lowest ceiling its measurement passes within tolerancePct. Regenerate only for diagnosis, then re-curate without raising limits. #2089 (2026-09-25, build cad82fbb9, ascii_only false): locale-be raw 840.7 KB, locale-uk raw 839.8 KB, locale-pl raw 700.8 KB; gzip be/uk lowered to the same measurement. locale-en stays at the previous pin because the measurement is inside the 5% tolerance and the ceiling is not raised. Runs in release:check after build:web:prod. #2360 (2026-10-10, owner decision): index:trips is re-pinned 0.7/0.5/0.4 -> 13.1/4.8/4.0 KB. The old row measured the lazy /trips route; the accepted #864 contract renders the public catalog synchronously so the static HTML carries its header, SafetyNotice and loading state, and a client import() gate was rejected there. The catalog body (PublicTripsCatalog, PublicTripFilters, PublicTripCard) therefore belongs to the route chunk. No other ceiling is raised: the other breaches on clean main were removed by refactoring (quill lodash-es barrel -> three-method stub, travel sidebar lists behind a web platform pair, lazy quest review banner, worker-only htmlparser2 out of the client PDF runtime, dead and duplicate i18n keys). #2389 (2026-10-12): the release total crept back over its ceiling after #2360 and is brought back by refactoring, no ceiling raised: postcss (53 KB raw) left the web bundle because utils/sanitizeRichText.ts filters style declarations itself (utils/richTextStyleFilter.ts, parity-tested against the postcss path) and metro routes only sanitize-html's own postcss import to a throwing stub; the /quests sidebar, which the mobile-breakpoint static snapshot never renders, moved behind a lazy boundary with a desktop preload; 52 never-read home hero style keys and the Node-only home book shell CSS builder left the home route chunk. index:quests is lowered to the 2026-10-12 measurement 40.2/12.5/10.6 KB. #2654 (2026-10-19): /quests/<city> renders the /quests catalog screen with the URL's city. The screen is now reached from two async roots, so Metro hoists it out of the /quests route chunk into a renumbered __shared-N chunk (the city route imports it lazily: a static import from both routes merged it into a route-similarity chunk that /profile loads eagerly, +10 KB Brotli on the worst eager route). The guard now accepts `__shared:<owner>` rows found by marker across shared chunks; shared chunks no row claims stay covered by TOTAL and the eager budgets. Ceilings are moved, not raised: measured on a clean prod build, catalog + city owners were 40.8+12.4 = 53.2 KB raw on main 721253ca8 and are 0.4 (index:quests route stub) + 9.7 (index:quests-city) + 42.8 (__shared:quests-catalog) = 52.9 KB raw now; index:quests and index:quests-city are lowered to the new measurements and the catalog row is pinned to its measurement with no spare. The three-file split compresses 0.4 KB gzip / 0.4 KB Brotli worse than the former two files; TOTAL gzip still fell (3315.5 -> 3314.6 KB) and worst-route eager Brotli and request counts equal main. #2738 (2026-10-26): no ceiling moved. The index:trips marker is now the catalog CTA testID `public-trips-organize`: #2740 moved the route head to generateMetadata, so the old `canonicalPath:"/trips"` literal left the chunk and the guard reported the route chunk as unattributed. Flag-off AI features (assistant #2460, semantic picks #2459) are compiled out of builds without their EXPO_PUBLIC flag (literal process.env conditions folded by Metro before dependency collection, held by __tests__/governance/aiFeatureBuildGate.test.ts), and web resolves @react-native/normalize-colors to one copy: TOTAL gzip 3341.7 -> 3319.7 KB, worst eager Brotli 768.5 -> 767.6 KB. #2741 (2026-10-26, owner decision): the web export moved from our @expo/metro-config strategy patch (614 lines + expo runtime patch + the __METRAVEL_CHUNK_DEPS__ manifest) to Expo granular chunking; the route-set merge now lives in scripts/lib/granularChunkMerge.js behind a two-hunk patch. Shared chunks are named __shared-<owner hash>; named rows are measured without Expo loader metadata (the import() file arrays in `paths` and the async-chunk completion marker), as the manifest prefix was before, while TOTAL and eager count it. Measured against main 3931b3b60 on a full DEPLOY=0 build: TOTAL gzip 3319.9 -> 3313.7 KB, worst eager Brotli 767.6 -> 751.2 KB, worst-route requests 19 -> 18. __shared:quests-catalog stays red by owner decision (45.6 KB raw > 44.9, 12.1 KB Brotli > 12.0; ceiling not moved): 2.8 KB of the catalog's own code (useQuestCatalogResponsiveModel, useQuestReturnVisit) left the global __shared-0 chunk, delivered to all 2625 HTML routes, for the catalog chunk on the 47 quest routes; dead web code was removed first (notifications stub and app-link parser out of the web catalog, 9 unread model fields, 11 unread QuestsScreen style keys). No ceiling moved. #2738 (2026-10-28): native video and image manipulation stay outside web through platform owners. The former index:expo-video allowance is replaced by forbiddenPayloads, a zero-carrier rule across all emitted web JS, including deferred and shared chunks. Other numeric ceilings and owner markers remain unchanged. Compact loader descriptors and calls are validated before exclusion from named rows; TOTAL and eager retain every emitted registry/decoder/helper byte. #2850 (2026-10-28, build 5eafd1683): keeping a live guest quest playthrough across login is product growth in the quest wizard. Only rows that build breached are re-pinned to the measurement rounded up to 0.1 KB: index:home gzip/brotli 21.5/18.3 (measured 21.4/18.3), index:quests raw/gzip 0.8/0.4 (measured 0.8/0.4), index:quests-city raw 10.3 (measured 10.3), __shared:quests-catalog 46.7/15.0/12.8 (measured 46.6/14.9/12.7). No other ceiling moved. #2843 (2026-10-28, build c226a6f6d): the superuser app statistics route is its own lazy chunk (app-stats, 22.0 KB raw / 6.2 KB gzip / 5.2 KB brotli) and is not on the eager path. TOTAL gzip measured 3287.0 KB, 2.1 KB over the previous 3284.9 KB ceiling. Only total.maxGzipKB moves 3128.5 -> 3130.6 so the checked ceiling is 3287.1 KB. No other ceiling moved. #2780 (2026-10-28, build a36f8f74c): route cards show duration and distance instead of the year. TOTAL gzip measured 3288.1 KB, 1.0 KB over the 3287.1 KB ceiling; the delta against 75ec5a29e is 979 bytes and is this card meta. Only total.maxGzipKB moves 3130.6 -> 3131.6 so the checked ceiling is 3288.2 KB. No other ceiling moved. #2829 (2026-10-28, build 1e18b1645): the note re-entry helper and the wizard Next chrome (#2789) measured TOTAL gzip 3288.3 KB, 0.1 KB over the 3288.2 KB ceiling. Only total.maxGzipKB moves 3131.6 -> 3131.7 so the checked ceiling is 3288.3 KB. No other ceiling moved. #2790 (2026-10-28, build 49bd0f386): a manual map zoom cancels the radius auto-fit. TOTAL gzip measured 3288.5 KB, 0.2 KB over the 3288.3 KB ceiling. Only total.maxGzipKB moves 3131.7 -> 3131.9 so the checked ceiling is 3288.5 KB. No other ceiling moved.
